mapper.select: SELECT is_active, role, UNIX_TIMESTAMP(withdrawn_at) AS withdrawn_at_epoch FROM member WHERE member_id = #{memberId}
SELECT * FROM member WHERE email = #{email} AND is_active = 1 LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM member WHERE provider = 'KAKAO' AND is_active = 1 AND provider_id = #{providerId} ORDER BY member_id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 FROM member WHERE email = #{email} AND is_active = 1
SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 FROM member WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND is_active = 1
SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 FROM member WHERE is_active = 1 AND REGEXP_REPLACE(COALESCE(phone, ''), '[^0-9]', '') = #{phone}
SELECT member_id, provider, email FROM member WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND is_active = 1
SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 FROM member WHERE provider = 'KAKAO' AND is_active = 0 AND provider_id = #{providerId}

SELECT *, CASE WHEN withdrawn_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS recoverable_within_30_days FROM member WHERE provider = 'KAKAO' AND is_active = 0 AND provider_id = #{providerId} AND withdrawn_at IS NOT NULL ORDER BY withdrawn_at DESC, member_id DESC LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE

SELECT *, CASE WHEN withdrawn_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS recoverable_within_30_days FROM member WHERE email = #{email} AND is_active = 0 AND withdrawn_at IS NOT NULL ORDER BY withdrawn_at DESC, member_id DESC LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO member (email, password, name, phone, profile_img, provider, provider_id, email_verified, role, zip_code, address, address_detail) VALUES (#{email}, #{password}, #{name}, #{phone}, #{profileImg}, #{provider}, #{providerId}, #{emailVerified}, #{role}, #{zipCode}, #{address}, #{addressDetail})
mapper.update: UPDATE member SET password = #{password}, name = #{name}, phone = #{phone}, provider = 'LOCAL', provider_id = NULL, email_verified = 'Y', is_active = 1, zip_code = #{zipCode}, address = #{address}, address_detail = #{addressDetail}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND provider = 'LOCAL' AND is_active = 0
UPDATE member SET is_active = 0, withdrawn_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND is_active = 1
UPDATE member SET is_active = 1, updated_at = NOW() WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND provider = 'KAKAO' AND is_active = 0
UPDATE member SET phone = #{phone}, profile_img = #{profileImg}, zip_code = #{zipCode}, address = #{address}, address_detail = #{addressDetail}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE member_id = #{memberId}
UPDATE member SET password = #{password}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND provider = 'LOCAL' AND is_active = 1
UPDATE member SET simple_password = #{simplePassword}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND is_active = 1
